snippet.title: Midwest 90 : Rapid City Gameplay Teaser
snippet.description:
We’ve come a long way since our first look a few years back. Our first Midwest 90: Rapid City gameplay teaser is finally here! 

We've got an all new demo for the low price of ✨FREE✨
🎮 Download now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1818480/Midwest_90_Rapid_City/

Love it? Wishlist us! Don’t? Tell us what you think, every bit of feedback helps us get better.
